notes.title: First Blink Patch
notes.content:
+Fixed main menu controller support bug.
+Art revamp on early levels.
+You can Blink with L Trigger on controllers now.
+Various cut scene fixes.

Thanks for your feedback and bug reports!
If you want to report a bug you found, please email us at support@nextrealitygames.com
Attaching a screenshot to the email would help tremendously.

Thanks!

tags.feature: +You can Blink with L Trigger on controllers now.
